task:
Galaxy map navigation: add vertical travel, cursor-anchored zoom and a two-finger pinch gesture (map review finding M11). apps/web only.

VERIFIED ON MAIN (a8d1b794): `apps/web/src/lib/spatial/galaxy-camera.ts` — `panGalaxyCamera` always preserves the focus Y; `zoomGalaxyCamera` only changes `distanceLy` about the current focus; pitch is clamped to one side of the plane (MIN 0.12 rad to PI/2). The pointer controller (find it under `apps/web/src/lib/spatial/` — the code that binds pointerdown/move/up and wheel on the canvas, with `touch-action: none`) stores a single active drag and ignores a second pointer, so there is no pinch zoom on touch devices. The Explore toolbar has + / −, rotate, Top down, Tilted and Reset view buttons; there is no elevation control.

WHAT TO DO:
1. Keep the existing default drag (pan) and shift-drag (orbit) exactly as they are. Add vertical travel: a modifier drag (Alt/Option-drag, or Ctrl-drag — pick one and document it in the on-canvas hint line) that moves the focus along galactic Y, plus two toolbar buttons "Up" / "Down" (accessible names "Move up" / "Move down") that step the focus Y by a distance proportional to the current range. Keep the camera's existing clamps and never let the focus leave the catalogue bounds already used by the camera helpers. Show the focus coordinates (X / Y / Z in LY, rounded) in the existing range/grid strip so the user can see where they are.
2. Cursor-anchored zoom: wheel zoom (and pinch) zooms toward the point under the pointer on the galactic plane (ray–plane intersection at the focus plane's Y), not toward the centre, so the thing under the cursor stays under the cursor. The + / − buttons keep zooming about the centre.
3. Touch: track up to two pointers; two-finger pinch zooms (anchored at the midpoint), two-finger drag pans; a one-finger drag keeps panning. Keep `touch-action: none` on the canvas. Pointer cancel/lost releases the gesture.
4. Keep "Reset view" and the Top down / Tilted presets; the reset returns Y to the previous anchored/reset value, not to zero, when the view had a focus.
5. All camera maths lives in `galaxy-camera.ts` as pure functions (`elevateGalaxyCamera`, `zoomGalaxyCameraTowards`, pinch helpers); the pointer controller only translates events into those calls. No change to the Babylon adapter beyond passing the pointer position through if needed. No change to what is rendered.

TESTS (vitest): pure camera tests — elevation changes only focus Y and respects clamps; cursor-anchored zoom keeps the plane point under the cursor fixed (project before and after, tolerance 1e-6) at several pitches and aspect ratios; pinch helper scales distance by the finger-distance ratio and anchors at the midpoint; pointer controller tests with synthetic PointerEvents for one-finger pan, two-finger pinch+pan, pointercancel release; component test for the Up/Down buttons and the coordinate readout. Existing camera and SpatialCanvas tests must keep passing. Update the on-canvas hint text test if one pins it.

VALIDATION: in apps/web `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`. CHANGES.md: one dated 2026-11-02 entry; note this is a user-visible interaction change that needs Product E2E/visual validation before production promotion and is not deployed.
